description: Routing collision tests — ambiguous prompts per collision pair, testing which skill fires.

pairs.pair: marketing strategy vs social modes vs positioning-gtm

evals.prompt: Create a social media plan with a content calendar and paid ad strategy for our B2B SaaS launch in Germany.
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing (social mode) for platform-level social media plan and content calendar.
evals.rationale: Specific request for platform-level social media plan and content calendar — marketing (social mode) owns this. positioning-gtm is for end-to-end stage-gated GTM, not campaign-level social planning.

evals.prompt: We need a full go-to-market strategy for our fintech SaaS — first customers, partnerships, European expansion, and regulatory path.
evals.expected_output: Routes to positioning-gtm for end-to-end stage-gated GTM with fintech archetype and Europe region.
evals.rationale: End-to-end stage-gated GTM with archetype-specific concerns (fintech, Europe, regulatory) — positioning-gtm owns this. marketing (strategy mode) is for campaign-level marketing detail after the GTM strategy.

evals.prompt: Define our positioning, messaging, target segments, and channel strategy for our consumer subscription app.
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing (strategy mode) for positioning, messaging, segmentation, and channel fundamentals.
evals.rationale: Marketing strategy fundamentals (positioning, messaging, segmentation, channels) — marketing (strategy mode) owns this. positioning-gtm adds stage-gated GTM structure only when SaaS vs fintech archetype or region materially changes the plan.

pairs.pair: idea-grill vs startup-business-builder vs challenge-review panel vs customer-perspective modes

evals.prompt: I have a rough idea for helping freelancers track expenses. What should I do first to figure out if it's worth pursuing?
evals.expected_output: Routes to idea-grill to narrow the vague idea, identify the segment and painful job, and form a researchable thesis before any building or evidence collection.
evals.rationale: Vague idea, no segment clarity — needs idea-grill to narrow and form a researchable thesis before any building or evidence collection.

evals.prompt: We have a clear segment (self-employed Germans confused about PKV), evidence of pain from Reddit, and want to build a business plan with customer discovery, MVP, and first-customer strategy.
evals.expected_output: Routes to startup-business-builder for zero-to-one business plan with customer discovery, MVP, first customers, and business model.
evals.rationale: Clear segment with evidence — past the idea-grill stage, ready for zero-to-one business building. The request is for a plan, not idea clarification.

evals.prompt: Three advisors reviewed our GTM plan and disagree on whether to launch B2C first or go through insurance brokers. Help us decide.
evals.expected_output: Routes to challenge-review panel mode for a multi-role adversarial review of a high-stakes strategic decision.
evals.rationale: High-stakes strategic decision with multiple informed perspectives already on the table — challenge-review panel mode's multi-role structure is the right fit. Not an idea-clarity or business-planning problem.

evals.prompt: Our consumer finance app is ready to launch in Germany. Challenge our packaging, pricing presentation, trust design, and cancellation policy from a German consumer's perspective.
evals.expected_output: Routes to challenge-review customer-perspective mode for evidence-grounded buying context and consumer trust challenge.
evals.rationale: Consumer service packaging and trust challenge for a specific market — challenge-review customer-perspective mode is built for exactly this. Use after evidence collection, before finalizing GTM.

pairs.pair: precedent-research case vs playbook modes

evals.prompt: What can I learn from how Airbnb and Uber grew their marketplaces in the early days?
evals.expected_output: Routes to precedent-research case mode for named-company case studies on Airbnb and Uber marketplace growth.
evals.rationale: Request for case studies on specific named companies — precedent-research case mode does company case studies. precedent-research playbook mode does anonymous founder/operator lessons by business archetype.

evals.prompt: What do successful founders say about building a B2B SaaS company in Europe — specifically about pricing, first customers, and avoiding common mistakes?
evals.expected_output: Routes to precedent-research playbook mode for anonymous founder/operator lessons by B2B SaaS archetype.
evals.rationale: Request for anonymous founder/operator lessons by archetype (B2B SaaS, Europe) — precedent-research playbook mode owns this. precedent-research case mode does named-company case studies.

pairs.pair: market-problem-discovery vs idea-grill vs evidence-scout

evals.prompt: I am curious about independent elder-care services in Germany. I do not have a product yet; find recurring customer problems, dissatisfied groups, and possible overlooked pockets before I choose an idea.
evals.expected_output: Routes to market-problem-discovery for source-grounded exploration before any founder intake. It should create a report and let the user select a candidate afterward.
evals.rationale: The user explicitly wants to discover problems and segments before selecting a hypothesis. Market discovery owns the divergent research and user-controlled handoff.

evals.prompt: I have a vague interest in helping small restaurants. Should we explore what frustrates them first, or figure out whether my inventory app idea is viable?
evals.expected_output: Asks the single market-discovery versus idea-validation routing question before starting either workflow.
evals.rationale: The user explicitly expresses uncertainty about the mode, so the agent should resolve that choice with one routing question rather than begin a grill or a collection run.

evals.prompt: I want to validate whether US freelance designers lose billable time because invoice follow-up is manual. Help me pressure-test that specific customer problem before I build anything.
evals.expected_output: Routes to idea-grill because the user has already chosen a segment and problem hypothesis to validate.
evals.rationale: This is a founder-chosen validation hypothesis, not a request to discover which problem or segment to pursue.

pairs.pair: competitor-research (teardown) vs marketing (social mode)

evals.prompt: Analyze what Facebook and Instagram ads my competitors are running — creatives, copy, CTAs, and how long the ads have been active.
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-research teardown mode, which now includes an ad-evidence step via scripts/evidence_scout/collect_ads.py.
evals.rationale: Analyzing competitor paid-ads intelligence is competitor analysis (collect_ads.py + Meta Ad Library), not planning our own social media campaigns — marketing (social mode) owns outbound campaign planning.

evals.prompt: Find customer pain evidence in public Facebook groups and Instagram hashtags for our PKV switching hypothesis.
evals.expected_output: Routes to evidence-scout for ScrapeCreators-backed social pain collection (--fb-groups, --ig-hashtags).
evals.rationale: Social pain evidence collection is evidence-scout's job via collect.py; competitor-research teardown mode analyzes competitor positioning, not customer pain.

pairs.pair: challenge-review tournament vs panel modes vs marketing (strategy mode)

evals.prompt: Generate 3 alternative GTM approaches for our fintech SaaS, have them compete, and tell me which one wins.
evals.expected_output: Routes to challenge-review tournament mode for generate-and-judge over multiple drafts.
evals.rationale: The user wants multiple drafts generated and judged against each other — challenge-review tournament mode owns this. challenge-review panel mode challenges an existing plan; positioning-gtm produces a single stage-gated strategy.

evals.prompt: Here is our launch plan. Tear it apart before we commit the budget.
evals.expected_output: Routes to challenge-review panel mode for adversarial review of an existing plan.
evals.rationale: An existing plan to challenge is challenge-review panel mode territory. The tournament generates new drafts; it does not review a supplied plan.

pairs.pair: brand-website-designer-builder vs brand-identity vs marketing (strategy mode)

evals.prompt: The business idea is validated and the brand direction is approved. Build a visually distinctive Next.js landing page for the primary customer segment and prepare it for Vercel.
evals.expected_output: Routes to brand-website-designer-builder for preference-led website implementation; it may consume a linked brand snapshot but must not rerun research.
evals.rationale: The request is implementation of a website from approved brand inputs, not independent brand discovery or a marketing plan.

evals.prompt: Independently develop a brand identity for my new service, including positioning, visual direction, typography, and logo concepts. Do not do market research.
evals.expected_output: Routes to brand-identity for independent branding; research workflows remain out of scope.
evals.rationale: Branding is explicitly requested independently of research and without website implementation.

evals.prompt: Ship two homepage hero variants and measure which CTA converts better using a simple server-side A/B test.
evals.expected_output: Routes to brand-website-designer-builder for Vercel Flags-based experimentation and analytics instrumentation.
evals.rationale: The requested artifact is website experimentation implementation, not campaign strategy.

evals.prompt: Build React components for my Next.js landing page
evals.expected_output: Routes to brand-website-designer-builder (website-build); not brand-ui-system components mode.
evals.rationale: React work on a marketing landing page is website implementation, not a branded component library.

evals.prompt: Add React components to my website hero section
evals.expected_output: Asks a clarifying question or routes to the website skill; never brand-ui-system components mode.
evals.rationale: A website section edit does not request a reusable branded component library.

evals.prompt: fix the design tokens on my website
evals.expected_output: Asks a clarifying question or routes to the website skill; never brand-ui-system kit mode.
evals.rationale: Website token fixes belong to website-build or clarification, not a new UI kit.

pairs.pair: competitor-research landscape vs scout vs teardown modes vs brand-website-designer-builder

evals.prompt: Map our competitive landscape: same-market competitors, similar companies in other countries, their services and prices, and how they use YouTube and Instagram. Suggest positioning white space.
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-research landscape mode with three lane outputs and no website build.
evals.rationale: This is the complete lane-aware market, analog and social/positioning workflow.

evals.prompt: Find competitors for my invoice automation idea; I only need a classified candidate list.
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-research scout mode for narrow discovery.
evals.rationale: The user explicitly requests discovery only, not synthesis or social analysis.

evals.prompt: Analyze these three competitor landing pages and their pricing CTAs.
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-research teardown mode for a supplied-URL teardown.
evals.rationale: A supplied-URL narrow marketing analysis remains owned by the existing analyzer.

pairs.pair: brand-asset-producer (imagery-style) vs brand-ui-system motion mode (motion-concept) vs brand-ui-system kit mode

evals.prompt: Before we produce any images for the brand, define the imagery style: realistic photography vs illustration vs hybrid, overlay treatment, subject mix (nature vs human faces), crop rules, and 2-3 style frames for approval.
evals.expected_output: Runs the imagery-style art-direction gate (brand-asset-producer in art-direction mode) producing an art-direction brief and style frames; no batch imagery production before approval.
evals.rationale: The request is the imagery-style gate that precedes asset production, not token or website work.

evals.prompt: Define the animation concept for our web page and assets: motion principles, duration and easing primitives, and signature moments like a hover crossfade from a drawn image to a realistic photo, plus reduced-motion fallbacks.
evals.expected_output: Runs the motion-concept gate (brand-ui-system motion mode, concept step) producing a motion-concept doc; tokenization and reference implementations come later in the motion stage.
evals.rationale: The request is the early motion-concept definition, not component or website implementation.

pairs.pair: business positioning vs operating model vs marketing expression vs standalone brand

evals.prompt: Compare strategic positions for my business and derive the operating model.
evals.expected_output: Choose the business position first; derive only requested implications.
evals.rationale: Choose the business position first; derive only requested implications.

evals.prompt: Derive the operating model from our selected position.
evals.expected_output: Use the selected position and derive activities before routines.
evals.rationale: Use the selected position and derive activities before routines.

evals.prompt: Write ad copy for our fixed-scope service.
evals.expected_output: Write the requested copy without a positioning exercise.
evals.rationale: Write the requested copy without a positioning exercise.

evals.prompt: Develop a standalone brand identity without market research.
evals.expected_output: Preserve standalone brand discovery.
evals.rationale: Preserve standalone brand discovery.

pairs.pair: pain-first gate: solution-first requests with a project context

evals.prompt: Build a landing page for my new idea: a relocation concierge for US retirees moving to Italy.
evals.expected_output: Route is website-build, but with --project set and problem_validation not passed the packet is gate_blocked with first_skill idea-grill: customer segment, journey, and pain points must be validated with web-searched evidence first.
evals.rationale: Pain-first rule: even solution-first requests on a business-track project start with segment/journey/pain validation before website work.

evals.prompt: Create a go-to-market strategy and launch plan for my meal-planning app for busy parents.
evals.expected_output: Route is gtm-strategy, gate_blocked with first_skill idea-grill until the pain gate passes or an explicit override is recorded.
evals.rationale: GTM commits resources; the pain-first gate requires validated customer segment, journey, and pain points first.

evals.prompt: Find competitors for my meal-planning app idea.
evals.expected_output: Not gate-blocked: discovery/evidence routes never require the pain gate.
evals.rationale: Evidence-gathering routes are how the pain gate gets passed; they must stay unblocked.

pairs.pair: claim falsification vs case appraisal vs evidence-scout

evals.prompt: Before final delivery, falsify claims in my reviewed claim ledger: try to disprove each material finding with adversarial web searches.
evals.expected_output: Routes to opportunity-risk-designer via the claim-falsification route (mode falsification): export claims only, run the claim-falsifier agent, apply verdicts to a copy of the ledger.
evals.rationale: Adversarial falsification of synthesized claims is a post-synthesis risk check owned by opportunity-risk-designer; evidence-scout collects new supporting evidence and the challenge panel critiques strategy, neither isolates the falsifier from the findings.

pairs.pair: geo-audit vs brand-website-designer-builder vs competitor-monitoring

evals.prompt: Run an AI citability audit on https://www.example.com before we launch.
evals.expected_output: Routes to geo-audit for a read-only audit of a public URL with the pinned GEO Optimizer CLI; fixes go back to the website workflow.
evals.rationale: A tool-backed citability audit of our own public site is geo-audit's scope. Broad AEO/GEO content and schema work stays with brand-website-designer-builder; recorded AI-answer visibility stays with competitor-monitoring.

evals.prompt: Set up AI citation tracking for our brand across ChatGPT and Gemini answers.
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-monitoring for an AI-answer panel, not to the site audit.
evals.rationale: Observing what engines answer is measurement of answers, not an audit of the site's markup and access.

evals.prompt: Run a GEO audit on https://www.example.com
evals.expected_output: Routes to geo-audit for a read-only tool-backed audit of the public URL.
evals.rationale: An audit of a named public URL is geo-audit's scope; website content changes come afterwards through the website builder.

evals.prompt: Fix my website for AEO/GEO so answer engines can use our content.
evals.expected_output: Routes to brand-website-designer-builder for AEO/GEO content, schema and access work on the site.
evals.rationale: Changing the site is website delivery work; geo-audit is read-only measurement.

evals.prompt: Is my site visible in ChatGPT?
evals.expected_output: Routes to competitor-monitoring for a declared AI-answer panel (offline recordings or the capped live collector), not a markup audit.
evals.rationale: Whether an engine names or cites the site is an answer observation owned by competitor-monitoring's AI-answer visibility capability.

pairs.pair: capability entry points: idea assessment, SEO content, customer search journey

evals.prompt: Assess this business idea and research customers
evals.expected_output: Routes to idea-grill first; once the hypothesis is researchable, evidence-scout is invoked next with the Skill tool for customer research, including the international commercial-precedent pass or a stated reason it does not apply.
evals.rationale: An idea assessment with customer research is chosen-idea validation: idea-grill makes the hypothesis researchable, then evidence-scout collects.

evals.prompt: Plan our SEO content
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing (seo-page-planning mode), which merges the search-journey, competitor content, customer-question and social-topic inputs with keyword_map.py merge.
evals.rationale: SEO content planning is keyword-to-page planning owned by marketing (strategy mode); the website skill implements pages afterwards.

evals.prompt: What will customers search for?
evals.expected_output: Routes to evidence-scout for the customer search-journey SERP study (search_journey.py), producing content-opportunities.json as hypotheses.
evals.rationale: What customers type at each journey stage is customer-evidence desk research owned by evidence-scout, before content planning.

pairs.pair: challenge-review modes vs marketing (strategy mode) vs brand-website-designer-builder (plain-text boundary)

evals.prompt: Red-team my business plan.
evals.expected_output: Routes to challenge-review panel mode (route startup-challenge-panel) for an adversarial review of an existing plan.
evals.rationale: Red-teaming an existing plan is the panel protocol; before the merge this phrasing fell through to clarification.

evals.prompt: Challenge my marketing strategy.
evals.expected_output: Stays with marketing (strategy mode); a generic challenge verb does not pull marketing work into challenge-review.
evals.rationale: challenge-review match phrases are specific (challenge panel, red-team my plan, strategy drafts, customer/buyer perspective review) so marketing requests keep their owner.

evals.prompt: Write landing page copy from the buyer perspective.
evals.expected_output: Stays with the website builder; only a buyer perspective review routes to customer-perspective mode.
evals.rationale: Website copy is website work; the customer-perspective phrase requires an explicit review.

pairs.pair: marketing modes (plain-text boundary)

evals.prompt: Plan my social media for the next quarter: platforms and a posting calendar
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing social mode through the posting-calendar phrase.
evals.rationale: Added in the marketing merge so plain-text dispatch reaches social mode; before the merge this asked for clarification.

evals.prompt: Build an organic social plan for Instagram
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing social mode.
evals.rationale: Organic social planning is social mode.

evals.prompt: Validate my channel idea: TikTok videos for insurance brokers
evals.expected_output: Routes to marketing channel-validation mode for a GO/PIVOT/KILL verdict and bounded test.
evals.rationale: A channel idea to validate before production is channel-validation mode.

evals.prompt: Give me content ideas for Instagram
evals.expected_output: Asks for scope; brainstorming content ideas is not a request to validate one.
evals.rationale: The validation phrases need the verb; bare content ideas must not be pulled into channel validation.

evals.prompt: Research what customers say on social media about invoicing
evals.expected_output: Asks for scope; customer voice on social media is research, not social planning.
evals.rationale: Social-media research must not route to social mode.

pairs.pair: evidence-scout default vs interview-kit mode

evals.prompt: Create an interview kit for the meal-kit evidence.
evals.expected_output: Routes to evidence-scout interview-kit mode: screener, guide and learning tracker from reviewed evidence.
evals.rationale: 'interview kit' names the interview-kit deliverable; before the merge it fell to clarification.

evals.prompt: Collect customer evidence for invoice automation pain.
evals.expected_output: Routes to evidence-scout's own research route, not the interview kit.
evals.rationale: Customer-voice collection stays on the evidence-scout route.

evals.prompt: Plan customer interviews to validate the pain.
evals.expected_output: Asks one scoping question: interviews without a named kit deliverable stay ambiguous.
evals.rationale: Unchanged against 3f1635c; no broad 'interview' phrase was added.

pairs.pair: opportunity-risk-designer pilot mode vs smoke test vs prioritization

evals.prompt: Design an insurtech pilot for broker quoting.
evals.expected_output: Routes to opportunity-risk-designer pilot mode (pain-gated, strategy-stage prerequisites) and applies the regulatory guardrails reference.
evals.rationale: 'insurtech pilot' names the pilot deliverable; before the merge it fell to clarification.

evals.prompt: Design a smoke test for the meal-kit offer.
evals.expected_output: Stays on the smoke-test route, not the pilot mode.
evals.rationale: Unchanged against 3f1635c.

evals.prompt: Design an MVP for our budgeting app.
evals.expected_output: Asks one scoping question; a bare MVP request is not routed to the pilot mode.
evals.rationale: Unchanged against 3f1635c; no broad 'MVP' phrase was added.
